title: The local scalar action of a normalized completed realization
statement: Let l be prime, X a scheme, and e a CompletedRealization of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. For a completed module M, a pro-etale test object U, a section a of the completed coefficient ring on U and m in M(U), let b be the underlying isomorphism of the completed coefficient sheaf to the condensed coefficient sheaf given by e.underlying at the regular module followed by e.unitIso. Then the internal action on e.F(M), evaluated on b(a) and e.underlying.inv(m), is e.underlying.inv(a times m). The internal section action is evaluated by first applying the presheaf-to-sheaf tensor comparison, then the internal module action. There is no scheme morphism or direct-image functor in this assertion.

source.place: paragraph (1), coefficient identification, expanded in lem-diagonal-completed-ordinary-square

proof.text: Choose the projection-normalized ring-sheaf comparison of lem-diagonal-completed-coefficient-ring-comparison. The specified inverse limit defining the completed ring stays limiting after forgetting to additive sheaves. Postcompose the scalar comparison by the ring comparison, then test equality with the identity after each completed coefficient projection. The two normalizations and cancellation of the finite constant-ring isomorphism give equality. Cancel the ring comparison to identify completedRealizationScalarIso.hom with the underlying inverse ring comparison. This is scalarComparison_eq in Lean.

First suppose U is pro-affine etale. Construct the free presheaf on its universe-lifted representable and sheafify it. Its identity basis vector gives completedFreeGenerator. The three explicit adjunctions construct completedFreeDesc M U m and prove its value on the generator.

For this pro-affine etale U, apply automatic linearity into the free target to the underlying comparison e.underlying.hom at completedFreeCell. Reconstruct the sectionwise module of e.F at that free cell, identify the scalar comparison with the ring comparison from step 1, and cancel the underlying isomorphism. This proves the desired action identity on the distinguished free generator (freeGenerator_action).

Apply e.F to the explicit generator-to-section map. Evaluate Mod.act_hom through the lax monoidal tensor comparison to prove map_action. Naturality of e.underlying.inv identifies its composites with the original generator map. Apply the mapped generator map to step 3, move it through the action using map_action, use its original linearity and its value on the generator, and obtain exactly the stated identity for arbitrary M and m over pro-affine etale U.

For arbitrary U, the equalizer sieve of the two desired sections contains the sieve generated by maps from pro-affine etale objects. Restriction commutes with the internal action via sectionModuleFunctor.map_smul, and with the scalar and underlying comparisons by naturality. The previous steps therefore give equality on every such object. The existing cover-density theorem for AffineProEt.toProEt (valid over every scheme X) makes this sieve covering; sheaf separatedness gives equality on U.

lean.statement:
theorem completedRealization_section_action (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (e : CompletedRealization l X) (M : DiagonalCompleted l X)
    (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (a : (Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion X l)).obj.obj U)
    (m : M.val.obj U) :
    coefficientSectionAction (e.F.obj M) U
        (completedRealizationScalarSection e U a)
        ((e.underlying.inv.app M).hom.app U m) =
      (e.underlying.inv.app M).hom.app U (a • m)
